Use the `[Feature]` action tag. Add a `[Project-Tag]` for project-specific context.

## Examples

```
@workspace [Feature] Implement customer loyalty points system: 1 point per ¥100 spent, redemption at checkout (1 point = ¥1), admin dashboard showing balance per customer.
```
